parts.text: What is the company's bereavement leave policy?

Under the company's Bereavement Leave Policy, eligible employees may take up to 5 consecutive paid working days off for the loss of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling) and up to 3 paid working days for extended family members. Additional unpaid time may be requested through your manager. For full details and formal submission guidelines, please refer to the [Bereavement Leave Policy](https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/bereavement-leave).

Employees are eligible for up to 5 paid days for immediate family members and 3 paid days for extended family members under the Bereavement Leave Policy (https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/bereavement-leave).

property.description: The model response must explicitly mention 5 paid days for immediate family and 3 paid days for extended family.
The response must include a grounded citation link to the Bereavement Leave Policy document.

parts.text: Are employees allowed to expense noise-canceling headphones?

Yes. Under the [Remote Work & Expense Policy](https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/expense-guidelines#peripherals), full-time remote and hybrid employees are eligible for a one-time reimbursement of up to $150 for noise-canceling headphones or equivalent audio equipment used for work calls. Claims must be submitted via Concur with itemized receipts within 60 days of purchase.

Full-time remote and hybrid employees can expense up to $150 for noise-canceling headphones under the Remote Work & Expense Policy (https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/expense-guidelines#peripherals).

property.description: The response must state the $150 reimbursement limit for remote/hybrid employees with a valid policy citation.

parts.text: What equipment is provided under the remote work policy for home office setup?

According to the [Remote Work Policy](https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/remote-work-policy#equipment), designated remote employees are eligible for standard enterprise IT equipment: one laptop, up to two external 27-inch monitors, a docking station, and a one-time $250 ergonomic accessory stipend. Requests must be placed via ServiceImmediately IT hardware catalog.

Remote employees receive a company laptop, up to two 27-inch external monitors, a docking station, and a $250 accessory stipend per the Remote Work Policy (https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/remote-work-policy#equipment).
Can I accept a gift basket from a vendor partner?

Per the [Code of Conduct & Ethics Policy](https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/code-of-conduct#gifts), employees may only accept perishable or promotional gifts valued at under $50 USD. Any gift exceeding $50, or any cash or cash equivalents (gift cards), must be politely declined or reported to the Ethics & Compliance Office.

Employees may accept gifts under $50 USD. Gifts over $50 or cash equivalents are prohibited and must be declared to Ethics & Compliance per Code of Conduct (https://hr.enterprise.internal/policies/code-of-conduct#gifts).
